draft_text: Wrenfold's advantage over Fennick-Base may extend to customer-service domains not seen in training.
revised_text: Wrenfold's advantage over Fennick-Base extends to the held-out customer-service domains (Insurance, Telecom and Utilities), where it achieves higher macro-F1 (85.7 vs 81.2, 83.9 vs 80.4, and 86.2 vs 82.0).
rationale: T1.r3–r5 show Wrenfold beats Fennick-Base on all three held-out domains (85.7>81.2, 83.9>80.4, 86.2>82.0). The sentence hedges with "may extend," but the evidence directly supports the advantage extending to these domains. No statistical test is reported, so "significant" is not claimed; the factual advantage is supported.
